# Shop Homepage Featured Products API

Retrieves featured products from the shop.app homepage feed (the product shelves shown to an anonymous visitor, such as trending stores, deals and category shelves) in a single upstream request.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "shop-app/homepage-featured-products"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## Pricing

Flat $0.03 per call. Failed calls are not charged.
